name: openwop-app
description: OpenWOP reference app — monorepo (backend/typescript + frontend/react). This root manifest only exposes the local CI gate; each workspace owns its own deps/build. See CLAUDE.md.

scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath scripts/git-hooks && echo 'pre-push gate enabled — runs npm run ci; bypass with git push --no-verify'
scripts.build:distribution: node scripts/gen-distribution.mjs && npm --prefix backend/typescript run build && npm --prefix frontend/react run build
scripts.ci:distribution: node scripts/gen-distribution.mjs --check && OPENWOP_DISTRIBUTION=slim-proof npm --prefix backend/typescript run build && OPENWOP_DISTRIBUTION=slim-proof npm --prefix frontend/react run build
